_comment: Site registry. Not secret - this belongs in git, unlike config/management.tpl.json.
Each site owns one /16 out of 10.0.0.0/8, identified by its octet. Within that:
The octet is the site's identity on the overlay network. It must be unique and
must never be reused - a retired site's routes can linger, and reissuing its
octet points them somewhere new. Retire an octet, do not recycle it.
Stay below 96: Kubernetes defaults put services at 10.96.0.0/12 and pods at
10.244.0.0/16. Those are cluster-internal and never routed over the overlay,
but overlapping them makes debugging needlessly confusing.
